ai_summary: Abbott India Limited reported strong unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing by approximately 4.3% year-over-year (YoY) and net profit growing robustly by over 17% YoY. Concurrently, the company announced a significant governance change, appointing Mr. Sudarshan Jain, an Independent Director, as the new Chairman of the Board, which enhances board independence. The limited review report from the statutory auditors did not raise any qualifications or red flags regarding the financial statements.
